name: @hadoku/service-kernel
description: The server parts any game keeps: edge auth and the tier gate, base path and bundle check, health and the busy probe, lifecycle, the JSON logger, the state directory, telemetry and capacity, per-caller limits, the browser relays, the erase registry, and createGameServer, which boots a game from its config and plugins. Knows no game; the app binds its service id, prefix and env names. MIT; imports only node built-ins, express, socket.io, platform-wire and @wolffm/*.
//peerDependencies: Peers, not dependencies: the app's own rooms-protocol/rooms-server serve the kernel too, so an app that builds them itself (watchparty, from its workspace) installs no second copy. Any 0.45 or later is enough (a floor, not a caret: a caret leaves every consumer outside the range at the first 0.46): the kernel uses only rooms-server's MultiRateLimiter and rooms-protocol's ParticipantId type.
